name: evidence-v5
goal: Each story gives concrete, observable evidence for at least one world condition
problem: Reworded atoms whose two paraphrases did not mean the same thing in v1-v4
note: Rewrites of the 9 atoms with teacher self-agreement < 0.5; a and b now ask the same thing at the same breadth. Written before any v5 answers were seen.

probes.a: Does {file} report interest rates or borrowing costs going up?
probes.b: Does {file} say that loans, mortgages or credit are becoming more expensive or harder to get?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report interest rates or borrowing costs going down?

probes.a: Does {file} report a shortage, export ban or price rise for metals, minerals or raw materials?
probes.b: Does {file} say that metals, minerals or raw materials are becoming harder or costlier to get?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report metals, minerals or raw materials becoming cheaper or easier to get?

probes.a: Does {file} report wages, salaries or pay going up?
probes.b: Does {file} say that workers are being paid more than before?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report wages, salaries or pay going down or being frozen?

probes.a: Does {file} report migrants, refugees or asylum seekers arriving in a country?
probes.b: Does {file} describe people moving into a country from abroad to live, work or seek safety?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report migrants or refugees leaving a country or being sent back?

probes.a: Does {file} report people suffering anxiety, depression, trauma or severe stress?
probes.b: Does {file} describe people's mental health being harmed or getting worse?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report people's mental health improving?

probes.a: Does {file} report households or companies struggling to repay what they owe?
probes.b: Does {file} describe people or firms in debt trouble, such as missed payments, defaults or bankruptcy?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report households or companies paying off what they owe?

probes.a: Does {file} report people in a local community helping or supporting each other?
probes.b: Does {file} describe neighbours, volunteers or local groups working together for their area?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report a local community falling apart or neighbours in conflict?

probes.a: Does {file} report people's freedom to speak, protest, vote or get a fair trial being restricted?
probes.b: Does {file} describe a government or authority limiting people's rights or freedoms?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report people's rights or freedoms being restored or protected?

probes.a: Does {file} report the public losing confidence in a government, court, police force or official?
probes.b: Does {file} describe people doubting, distrusting or turning against a public institution?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report the public's confidence in a public institution growing?
